Exterior

Exterior Detail

A safe, thorough hand wash that brings the gloss back.

Price£140

Your choice carries through to the booking form — you won’t be asked twice.

Prefer to talk it through? Call 07907 019798

A proper exterior clean that lifts dirt, grime and bonded contamination without dragging it across your paint. No brushes, no swirls, no shortcuts.

What's included

Every step, listed.

Regular upkeep, improving shine, and keeping the car looking well presented between bigger details.

  • Bodywork and tyres soaked in citrus pre-wash and snow foam
  • Wheel arches cleaned
  • Wheels soaked in non-acidic wheel cleaner
  • Exterior pressure rinse
  • Wheels treated with fallout remover
  • Road tar removed from bodywork and wheels
  • Wheel barrels, faces and lug nuts hand-cleaned with soft brushes and wheel woolies
  • Bodywork washed with premium shampoo and a plush wash mitt
  • Door and boot shuts cleaned
  • Bodywork dried with luxury microfibre towels
  • Wheels dried, tyres dressed on request
  • Hand polish applied
  • Ceramic spray wax applied — three months of protection
  • Exterior glass cleaned with non-smear cleaner
  • Colour restored to exterior plastics

Basic vs Premium

What Premium adds

Premium isn't a bigger version of the same wash — it's a different level of work. This is exactly what the extra buys.

  • Full multi-stage chemical decontamination to dissolve iron fallout, tar and bonded contaminants a wash can't reach
  • One-stage machine polishing to reduce light scratches, swirl marks and oxidation
  • Deep cleaning of badges, trims, grilles and intricate crevices
  • Enhanced wheel and brake-dust removal, including behind the spokes
  • Upgraded ceramic sealant or wax for longer-lasting protection
  • Exhaust tips polished
  • Rubber trims conditioned
  • Glass deep-cleaned and treated for better clarity and water beading

Best for: Neglected paintwork, cars going up for sale, or anyone who wants a noticeably deeper gloss and protection that lasts.
